gloss: outside the range; out of scope; out of bounds

definitions.gloss: outside the range; out of scope; beyond the limits
definitions.explanation: Outside a defined range, area, or scope. Composed of {範囲|はんい} (range, scope) plus the suffix {外|がい} (outside).

examples.japanese: それは{範囲外|はんいがい}だ。
{電波|でんぱ}の{範囲外|はんいがい}にいる。
その{質問|しつもん}は{私|わたし}の{担当|たんとう}の{範囲外|はんいがい}です。
examples.english: That question is outside my area of responsibility.

notes:
{範囲|はんい} (range, scope) plus the suffix {外|がい} (outside). The antonym is {範囲内|はんいない} (within range).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電波|でんぱ}の{範囲外|はんいがい}: out of signal range
- {対象|たいしょう}{範囲外|はんいがい}: not covered / not eligible
- {想定|そうてい}の{範囲外|はんいがい}: beyond what was anticipated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {範囲内|はんいない}: within the range / within the scope

cross_references.label: within the range / within the scope
